name: Bulgogi
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 lb (450 g) beef suitable for grilling, sliced as thin as possible
3 green onions, sliced on the bias

steps: Combine all the ingredients in a big bowl. Marinate for at least 30 minutes, but marinating overnight will get the best flavor and tenderization.

culture.text: Bulgogi is a gui made of thin, marinated slices of meat, most commonly beef, grilled on a barbecue or on a stove-top griddle. It is also often stir-fried in a pan in home cooking. Sirloin and rib eye are frequently used cuts of beef for the dish. Bulgogi is a very popular dish in South Korea, where it can be found anywhere from upscale restaurants to local supermarkets as pan-ready kits.
